notes.title: Patch 006: BIG UPDATE - 02/03/2022
notes.notes:
Ahoy there scoundrels! You may have noticed a huge update dropping in the last few hours that's larger than a leviathan's carcass. 

The Table of Tales team have been working hard to address many of the issues that have been raised by players since the game's release last year - especially for those of you not playing in VR. Update and bug fixes include:

[list]
[*]New simplified control layouts that are easily accessible at all times
[*]Improved non-VR cameras that better focus on narrative interactions and other key gameplay moments
[*]Camera's field-of-view now adjusts between in-game, backdrop and cinematic mode
[*]Removal of duplicate ability cards that were not clearing from previous checkpoints
[*]Small art fixes such as the removal of duplicate chests
[*]Fixed a bunch of areas where the game was locking for some players during some interactions
[*]Improved a number of interactions during combats to make selection and movement easier
[*]A host of other small fixes and improvements throughout the game
[/list]

A huge thank you for all the great feedback (good and bad) over the last few months. We've read every message and tried to address as many of the major issues as possible. Thanks too for all the lovely reviews - it means a lot to us!

Cheers me' hearties!

[i]The Tin Man and Zero One team[/i]

notes.title: Patch 004: Hotfix - 09/22/2021
notes.notes:
Once again, a massive thank you to everyone that has played [i]Table of Tales: The Crooked Crown[/i] over the past week! There have been some great reviews and feedback.

We have just pushed out a new patch that addresses a couple of things:

[list]
[*] Resolved issue with Platinum achievement not being triggered.
[*] Added Raise View and Lower View buttons to the menu to allow players to adjust their height over the table.
[/list]

As always please keep your feedback coming and if you've played the game please consider leaving us a review.

Beware the Kraken!

[i]The Tin Man and Zero One team[/i]

notes.title: Patch 003: Hotfix - 09/20/2021
notes.notes:
Hi there. We've pushed out a patch that should fix some of the issues some players have been having when launching the game in VR and flatscreen (non-VR mode).

As always, we're constantly tracking the forums so let us know if you have any issues.

Cheers!

[i]The Tin Man and Zero One team[/i]

notes.title: Patch 002: Hotfix - 09/12/2021
notes.notes:
A huge thank you to everyone that has played [i]Table of Tales: The Crooked Crown[/i] in the last 24 hours! We've had some lovely feedback and awesome reviews from the community. 

It's not been without a few small hiccups though and the team have been working hard to fix some controller issues. This new patch should address those  - here are the official patch notes:

[list]
[*] Resolved Vive UI not displaying in Developer Bindings
[*] Added controls to Pause Menu
[*] Redesigned Vive Index's Knuckle bindings
[*] Update Developer Bindings to reflect new mappings
[*] Menu bug fix
[/list]

We'll be tracking the forum, so if you are still having problems with controller bindings or any other issues, please let us know. If you've sailed around the Crown Islands with those pesky scoundrels and want to share your thoughts, we'd love a review too! 

Sail safely!

[i]The Tin Man and Zero One team[/i]
